'''Jeoff Tevez''' was the [[Director/Legends|director]] of [[Kanauer Corporation/Legends|Kanauer Corporation's]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in the [[Thrugii Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. His son, [[Semler Tevez]], worked with him.<ref name="BSS" />
